aarti.tek: O Murāri, your Name is the āratī and the holy bath; without the Name of Hari all the world's display is false.
aarti.pad1: Your Name is the seat, your Name the stone for grinding sandal, your Name the saffron I take and sprinkle. Your Name is the water, your Name the sandalwood: chanting the Name, I grind it, and taking it I offer it to you alone. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Your Name is the lamp, your Name the wick, your Name the oil I take and pour into it. I have lit the light of your Name, and all the realms are filled with light. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Your Name is the thread, the Name the garland of flowers; the eighteen loads of plants are all defiled. What should I offer you of what you yourself have made? Your Name is the fly-whisk I wave over you. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: The eighteen Purāṇas, the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage, the four sources of birth: this is the way of the whole world. Says Ravidās: your Name is the āratī; the True Name, O Hari, is the food offered to you. ॥4॥
